templates.name: TYPO3 Composer Security
templates.description:
Reports vulnerable composer packages of a TYPO3 installation.

Requires EXT:zabbix_client (>= 14.3) with the GetComposerPackages operation, and outgoing HTTPS from the Zabbix server or proxy to api.osv.dev and packagist.org.

Add this template in addition to the general TYPO3 template and set {$TYPO3_CLIENT_KEY} on the host.

How it works: the extension only delivers the package inventory. OSV performs the version matching, the Packagist advisory API supplies CVE id, severity, title and link. Both are joined on the GitHub advisory id, which keeps the check at two HTTP requests per run - JavaScript preprocessing in Zabbix is limited to 10 seconds.

items.name: TYPO3 composer packages
items.description: Installed composer packages with versions, from the GetComposerPackages operation of EXT:zabbix_client.

items.name: TYPO3 composer packages: checkable
items.description: Packages with a comparable release version.

items.name: TYPO3 composer packages: not checkable
items.description: Packages installed from a branch (dev-*). They have no comparable version and are deliberately excluded from the CVE match, because an unparsable version makes every advisory look like a hit.

items.name: TYPO3 composer security audit
items.description: Matches the inventory against OSV (version matching) and enriches the hits from the Packagist advisory API (CVE, severity, title, link). Needs outgoing HTTPS from the Zabbix server or proxy.

items.name: TYPO3 security: vulnerabilities total
items.description: Discards the value when the audit fails, so a broken check freezes the counter instead of reporting a false all-clear.

triggers.name: TYPO3: composer security audit failed
triggers.event_name: TYPO3: composer security audit failed on {HOST.HOST}
triggers.description:
The audit itself did not run: {ITEM.VALUE}

Usual causes: the Zabbix server has no outgoing HTTPS to api.osv.dev or packagist.org, or one of the two is unreachable. The severity counters keep their last value while this is active, so they are stale, not clean.

triggers.name: TYPO3: composer security audit has no data
triggers.event_name: TYPO3: composer security audit has no data on {HOST.HOST}
triggers.description: No audit result for 3 hours. Check whether /zabbixclient/ is reachable and whether {$TYPO3_CLIENT_KEY} matches the apiKey in the extension configuration.

triggers.name: TYPO3: {ITEM.VALUE} composer package(s) cannot be checked for vulnerabilities
triggers.event_name: TYPO3: {ITEM.VALUE} composer package(s) cannot be checked for vulnerabilities on {HOST.HOST}
triggers.description: These packages are installed from a branch (dev-*) and have no comparable version, so no CVE statement is possible for them. Normal on development instances, worth a look on production. Disabled by default.
